Description: The date in YYYYMM format which represents the end of the financial year. For example, 201803 represents March 2018, which was the end of the 2017-2018 fiscal year. The Revenue Outturn contains expenditure which took place over the course of a whole financial year.
The ONS local authority code.
A Local Government Finance code, which MHCLG uses internally to represent local authorities. These are unique to each local authority, similar to the ONS local authority code.
The name of the local authority.
The submission status. Takes one of three values: submitted, not submitted, or total. Totals are calculated, further information available on the Metadata - totals page.

The general classification of the local authority. A local authority's classification is related to the functions it carries out and how they are financed. More information on local authority types is available at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/local-government-structure-and-elections

The detailed classification of the local authority. A local authority's classification is related to the functions it carries out and how they are financed. More information on local authority types is available at https://www.gov.uk/guidance/local-government-structure-and-elections
